question: Related Questions Q. In my dream I was there with others, on the sky one white horse with wings (buraq) standing 2775 views Q. I want to ask you that in most of the time i see in my dream that I am flying above the ground level it is such that in my dream I start believing that I have power to fly above the ground level when ever I apply much force I fly much more fast and much more high. 1360 views Q. assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarak atuhu dear mufti sir, i perfomred salat ul haja in order to wake up for my fazr prayers.right before fazr adhan i had a dream of my already expired fufi,in my dream i knew she is no more in this world.i was ill in my dream and she was continously walking towards me.i told my brother that i saw her but he was not able to see her.only i cud see her.some doctor also put injection to me in dream before the upward event occured.then my dream broke 5 mins before fazr adhan. jazakallah. waiting for your beneficial service. 1455 views Q. Dream 1554 views Q. My fiance (would be wife) has seen in the dream that there is a large gathering of people in the majlis of some pious man (Buzareg) and my fiance is also there. The Buzareg called my fiancee and told her why are you doing like this? He did not mention what she did wrong. After that he told her that Hazoor Saw is angry with you. Now I am worried about this dream. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. She saw this dream few days back. We have not yet done Nikah & are engaged (Mangni). Alhamdulillah I am attached with Tableeg work. She is not regular in prayers and sometimes we talk about sex etc. I am too much worried about it, please tell me the tabeer as soon as possible. I have seen the dream that I am going out of the home before that i am using kajal to put on my leg at that time so many people were present at my home . So could u please tell the tabeer of this dream. 1447 views Q. دس سال پہلے میں مسلمان ہواتھا، میرے والدین کا انتقال ہوگیاہے، میرے دوست کے والدین ہی میرا خیال رکھتے تھے، وہ لوگ میرے لیے دلہن تلاش کررہے ہیں، میرے مسلمان ہونے کی وجہ سے بہت ساری لڑکیوں نے مجھے مسترد کردیاہے،میں ان پر الزام نہیں دے رہاہوں، بلکہ مجھے اتفاق ہے کہ ہر ایک کو اپنا شریک حیات چننے کا حق ہے، لیکن میری صورت حال میں سبھی لوگ ایک ہی وجہ بتاتے ہیں۔ ایک اور بات میں شیئر کرنا چاہوں گاکہ پوری دنیا میں اسلام بہت تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے، ( اللہ کا شکرہے)۔حال ہی میں بی بی سی /سی این این (یقین نہیں ہے، بلکہ سناہے)نے اسلام کا سروے کیا تو اسلام ہی ایک ایسا مذہب ہے جو ہر سال تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے۔ الحمد للہ۔ میں صرف یہ وجہ جاننا چاہتاہوں کہ کیوں لوگ سمجھتے ہیں کہ سارے نومسلم گناہ گار ہیں؟ اور ان کو مسترد کیا جاتاہے؟ میرا خیال ہے کہ حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے علاوہ سبھی لوگ نومسلم ہیں اور اسلام میں داخل ہوئے ہیں؟اگر میں غلط کہہ رہا ہوں تو صحیح رہنمائی فرمائیں۔ 1338 views Q. I have a doubt am working as a doctor. If i unintentionally prescribe a wrong medicine to one of my patient which might be a life threatening to him and if somthing wrong happens to him will it be accountable with Allah {s.w.a.t} 1859 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My brother in law lives in Canada. I saw a dream last night (I don?t know the time). I saw that my husband and my mother in law have come to our home. It is not our real home but in the dream it is our home. They ring the bell. I open the door. They come inside. I did not see my husbands face but his shirt and pant is recognized by me. I follow him. When he turns around, I see that he is not my husband but my brother in law. His one hand and half face has some major skin disease. It looked terrible and scary. Then everyone starts discussing that he got this disease in Canada and because the treatment is very expensive in Canada, he has come here to treat himself. Please interpret this dream for me. Jazakallahu khaire! 1670 views Q. I'm an umarried girl and I've been wanting to get married for a long time. Today, I had a dream in which I was getting married ( I don't remember who to ),and a lot of people were coming and congratulating me and i was feeling extremely shy. I've heard seeing oneself getting married in a dream is not a good sign...please interpret my dream for me. i'm very worried. 1641 views Q. My female friend has two kids. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45136 Country: India Title: Dream Question: I had asked Allah for a thing in the salatul hajah and the same day I got this dream. I saw my nephew and niece running for chocolates and then my niece, she is around 5 years old got and gave me chocolates and I ate it. Then my nephew came and snatched away the chocolates from her and she started crying. I was trying to convince her and then I gave her my chocolate and then I woke up. I do not know whether she was convinced or not in the dream. Please let me know what this dream means. Answer ID: 45136 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 661/517/H=1434) It is nice dream. In-shaAllah, you shall attain in some of your objectives. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
